# spaceman repo

A space's repositories: list, show, add, edit, remove and sync (--space).

Aliases: `repos`, `repository`, `repositories`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman repo create`](#spaceman-repo-create) | Add a repository (the node clones auto repositories at once) |
| [`spaceman repo delete`](#spaceman-repo-delete) | Remove a repository from the space (its folder on the node stays) |
| [`spaceman repo get`](#spaceman-repo-get) | A repository (ID or name) with the node's latest report |
| [`spaceman repo list`](#spaceman-repo-list) | A space's repositories with the node's latest report |
| [`spaceman repo sync`](#spaceman-repo-sync) | Ask the node to clone what is missing, fetch and report |
| [`spaceman repo update`](#spaceman-repo-update) | Edit a repository (only the flags given change; name and path are fixed) |

## spaceman repo create

Add a repository (the node clones auto repositories at once).

```sh
spaceman repo create <name> [flags]
```

API: `create-space-repository` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman repo create --space payments api --url git@github.com:acme/api.git --path repos/api --default-branch main
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--clone-policy` | string |  | auto (clone while the node holds the lease), on_demand (when a run needs it) or manual (never) |
| `--default-branch` | string |  | default branch (default main) |
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--path` | string |  | folder in the space folder (default the name; fixed after creation) |
| `--role` | string |  | code or kb |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--url` | string |  | clone URL without credentials (https://, ssh:// or git@host:path; the node's own Git authentication is used) |

## spaceman repo delete

Remove a repository from the space (its folder on the node stays).

```sh
spaceman repo delete <repository> [flags]
```

API: `get-space-repository`, `delete-space-repository` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman repo sync

Ask the node to clone what is missing, fetch and report.

Missing auto and on_demand repositories are cloned, the named repositories (default every repository with a URL) are fetched from their configured URL, and every repository is inspected. The report arrives asynchronously: see `spaceman repo list`. Nothing is reset, merged, pushed or deleted.

```sh
spaceman repo sync [flags]
```

API: `sync-space-repositories` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman repo sync --space payments --repository api
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fetch` | bool |  | fetch from the remotes (default true) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--repository` | string, repeatable |  | repository (name or ID) to fetch (repeatable; default all) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
